name: Fuel the Data: Crime and Socioeconomic Factors in the United States
description: A state-level dataset integrating FBI Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) offense data (2024) with USDA Economic Research Service socioeconomic indicators (poverty rate 2023, unemployment rate 2023, median household income 2022) for 48 U.S. states. Created for IS 477 Final Project at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

spatialCoverage.name: United States of America
spatialCoverage.description: 48 U.S. states (Florida, Minnesota, and District of Columbia excluded due to data formatting issues)

variableMeasured.name: Poverty Rate
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of population below the federal poverty line (2023)

variableMeasured.name: Violent crime
variableMeasured.description: Total violent crime offenses reported to law enforcement (2024), aggregated to state level

variableMeasured.name: Property crime
variableMeasured.description: Total property crime offenses reported to law enforcement (2024), aggregated to state level
